title: Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent are now legacy
body: [Knowledge Assistant](/aws/en/agents/agent-bricks/knowledge-assistant) and [Supervisor Agent](/aws/en/agents/agent-bricks/multi-agent-supervisor) are now [legacy](/aws/en/release-notes/runtime/databricks-runtime-ver) offerings. For new agents written in code, Databricks recommends the [Agent Bricks CLI](/aws/en/agents/custom-agents/agent-bricks-cli). To build agents without code, use [Genie Agents](/aws/en/genie-agents). See [Legacy agent offerings](/aws/en/agents/legacy).
